approvers: Owner decides alone; main contractor or client if they require it
reason: We don't buy this today and I'm not opening a new budget line for it. At about 19 euro per m2 it costs several times what I pay for film and tape, and I buy the cheapest that is good enough.
objection: In July and August half the facade is in full sun, so when can you even apply it? On top of that I'd pay 19 euro per m2 for something film and tape does for under 1 euro of material, and a 50% deposit and an 18-month removal obligation are more than a 7-person firm wants to take on.
instead: Keep taping and covering the frames with cheap protection film, and wipe or clean the glass at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor or client making it a requirement and paying for it, or a proven price close to film cost per m2 with no deposit.
